payload.message: [dev-team] orphan-signal:task:FIX-DEVTEAM-WIP-BUDGET-COUNTS-BLOCKED-INPROGRESS-ROWS was adoptable (server-reaper, orphaned_at epoch 1786053027) but the underlying task had ALREADY reached DONE_VERIFIED at 2026-08-06T20:50:33Z (commit 509bf1bd2, qa direct-commit verify) and was cold-evicted to archive/2026-08.json (commit 36abe3c99) BEFORE the orphan-signal was ever read by a dev-team tick. Root cause: the reaper converts a dead session's expired in_progress claim into an orphan-signal purely from TTL expiry, with no terminal-status recheck against the current board at emission time -- if the dead session's own spawned QA child finished and committed independently before the parent session's stale lock expired, the resulting orphan-signal is born stale and would cause a future dev-team tick to needlessly re-claim + re-flip + re-spawn an already-shipped task, per docs/agents/dev-team/flow/orphan-adoption.md (no terminal-status precheck step exists there either). This tick's dev-team session caught it via manual board recheck before adopting and skipped adoption -- no bad action taken. Prior-art check: no existing backlog row found for this defect class. Recommend: (1) reaper-side terminal-status check before emitting orphan-signal, and/or (2) orphan-adoption.md gains a board-recheck step (task_list_held is read-only cheap) before claim+flip+spawn -- mirrors the already-known feedback_orphan_signal_adoption_stale_intent_no_board_recheck.md and feedback_orphan_adoption_missing_terminal_status_precheck.md lessons, this is a live recurrence of that exact class.
